title: Northwind Supply invoices: what's changing
intro: You reported that a credit applied partway through a month was charged again on the next invoice. **I have a fix ready.** It will take effect the next time a mid-month credit is applied, so nothing on your past invoices will change, and it will not refund the one duplicate charge from March: I have credited that separately.
The same release will also correct how discounts are labeled. That change is cosmetic; every total will stay the same.
preview_caveat: Preview: the relabeled invoice below is your April invoice run through the new labels. Your invoices will show them from the next one issued.

examples.heading: The fix: a mid-month credit will be charged once
examples.explanation: **Example only.** Your existing invoices will not change. This shows how the next invoice after a mid-month credit will be calculated, using one of your own April orders as the starting point.

blocks.title: Next invoice after a $120.00 mid-month credit

examples.heading: Also in this release: discount labels
examples.explanation: Discounts will show the promotion they came from, in place of the single word "Discount". Amounts and totals will stay the same.
